question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?
reasoning_content:

1. RJF-TRADE-2026-11-12-WM-01#0: Raymond James will add $18.7B and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division as Pinnacle merges Synovus Securities and Pinnacle Asset Management. This is a strategic expansion of the Pinnacle relationship.

2. RJF-TRADE-2026-09-29: launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios (product launch) - strategic.

Actually the announcement of the closed transaction... hmm.

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division as Pinnacle Financial Partners merges Synovus Securities and Pinnacle Asset Management; the advisors are expected to transition in May 2027.
items.quote: Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division... as an existing FID program merges with Synovus Financial Corp... The advisors are expected to transition in May 2027.

items.text: Raymond James announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model portfolio product combining equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies.
items.quote: this week, the firm announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework that combines equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies.

items.text: Raymond James launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program, partnering with Capital Group American Funds, for small businesses with up to 100 employees.
items.quote: The firm has launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program... The firm has partnered with Capital Group American Funds for the program, which is designed for small businesses with up to 100 employees

items.text: Raymond James agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager with more than $46 billion under management, adding Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management; the transaction closed in May 2026.
items.quote: the firm agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager with more than $46 billion under management... That transaction closed in May 2026 and added Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management's multi-boutique structure.

cells.reason: The passages describe several strategic announcements and corporate actions by Raymond James within the window: the FID expansion via the Synovus/Pinnacle deal, the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, the SIMPLE IRA program launch, and the Clark Capital acquisition (announced January 2026, closed May 2026).
